description: Figure 19 is a bar chart that illustrates the average probing accuracy for different Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) variations. The horizontal axis displays the MLP configurations, which are labeled with the size(s) of the hidden layer(s) in square brackets, such as [256], [512], [256, 256], [512, 512], and [1024]. The vertical axis represents the average probing accuracy, with a scale ranging from 0 to 100. The chart shows that the accuracy varies significantly across the different MLP configurations, with the highest accuracy achieved by the [1024] configuration, followed by the [512, 512] configuration. The [256, 256] and [512] configurations show lower accuracy, while the [256] configuration has the lowest accuracy among the tested variations.
